purpose: validate the end-to-end V4 corpus pipeline on one fresh bug before committing to 12, and measure real per-candidate cost

case.defect: ctx.request.length used ~~len, truncating Content-Length to a signed 32-bit integer; declared sizes above 2GB wrap
case.fresh: not used in V0-V3.3 (prior koa cases were #1998 and #1999)

frozen_capture_screening.note: this service performs no pg/fetch work, so the incident carries no boundary events. Capture and replay are still supported, but such a case exercises less of what an executable incident uniquely provides. Candidate selection should prefer bugs whose reproduction depends on real boundary state.

measured_cost_per_candidate.assessment: the corpus pipeline is cheap per candidate in machine time; the real cost is understanding each bug well enough to write faithful scaffolding
